# Load Data

```{r}
df <- read_csv("Data/merged_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

df_analysis <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(fsm), !is.na(age))

print(paste("Analysis N:", nrow(df_analysis)))
```

# Prepare Outcome + Strategies

```{r}
prep_dca_df <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      outcome_cirrhosis = if_else(fsm >= 12.5, 1L, 0L),
      strategy_age35 = if_else(age > 35, 1L, 0L),
      strategy_age40 = if_else(age > 40, 1L, 0L),
      strategy_age45 = if_else(age > 45, 1L, 0L),
      obesity = case_when(
        is.na(bmi) ~ NA_character_,
        bmi >= 30 ~ "Obese (BMI ≥ 30)",
        bmi < 30 ~ "Not obese (BMI < 30)"
      )
    )
}

strategy_labels <- list(
  strategy_age35 = "Age > 35",
  strategy_age40 = "Age > 40",
  strategy_age45 = "Age > 45"
)

threshold_grid <- seq(0, 0.4, by = 0.01)

plot_xlim <- c(0, 0.4)
plot_ylim <- c(-0.01, 0.3)

legend_label <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "Treat All" ~ "Screen All",
    x == "Treat None" ~ "Screen None",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

color_map <- function(labels) {
  # Treat all/none are always black; age strategies get consistent colors
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(labels))
  names(out) <- labels
  out[labels %in% c("Screen All", "Screen None")] <- "black"
  out[labels == "Age > 35"] <- "#1b9e77"
  out[labels == "Age > 40"] <- "#d95f02"
  out[labels == "Age > 45"] <- "#7570b3"
  out
}

linetype_map <- function(labels) {
  out <- rep("solid", length(labels))
  names(out) <- labels
  out[labels == "Screen None"] <- "dotted"
  out
}

legend_breaks <- function(labels_present) {
  desired <- c("Screen All", "Screen None", "Age > 35", "Age > 40", "Age > 45")
  desired[desired %in% labels_present]
}

df_dca <- prep_dca_df(df_analysis) %>%
  mutate(
    hiv = case_when(
      hiv == "Positive" ~ "HIV infection",
      hiv == "Negative" ~ "No HIV infection",
      TRUE ~ hiv
    ),
    hbv = case_when(
      hbv == "Positive" ~ "HBV infection",
      hbv == "Negative" ~ "No HBV infection",
      TRUE ~ hbv
    ),
    aboriginal = case_when(
      aboriginal == "Indigenous" ~ "Aboriginal and/or\nTorres Strait Islander",
      TRUE ~ aboriginal
    ),
    hazardous_alcohol_use = case_when(
      hazardous_alcohol_use == "Yes" ~ "Hazardous alcohol use",
      hazardous_alcohol_use == "No" ~ "No hazardous alcohol use",
      TRUE ~ hazardous_alcohol_use
    ),
    csph = case_when(
      fsm_20 == 1 ~ "CSPH (>20 kPa)",
      fsm_20 == 0 ~ "No CSPH (\u226420 kPa)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

df_dca %>%
  count(outcome_cirrhosis) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))
```

# Subgroup DCA

```{r}
sanitize_level <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_trim() %>%
    dplyr::if_else(. == "", "Missing", .) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_")
}

run_dca_subset <- function(data, subgroup_name, subgroup_level) {
  # Require both events and non-events for DCA
  if (nrow(data) < 50 || n_distinct(data$outcome_cirrhosis) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  dca_result <- dca(
    formula = outcome_cirrhosis ~ strategy_age35 + strategy_age40 + strategy_age45,
    data = data,
    thresholds = threshold_grid,
    label = strategy_labels
  )

  dca_tbl <- dca_result %>%
    as_tibble()

  dca_tbl <- dca_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      label_display = legend_label(as.character(label))
    )

  breaks_here <- legend_breaks(unique(dca_tbl$label_display))
  colors_here <- color_map(breaks_here)
  linetypes_here <- linetype_map(breaks_here)

  p <- dca_tbl %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = net_benefit, color = label_display, linetype = label_display)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = plot_xlim, ylim = plot_ylim) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors_here, breaks = breaks_here, name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = linetypes_here, breaks = breaks_here, name = NULL) +
    guides(
      # Use a single legend (color), but override keys to show dashed Screen None
      color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = unname(linetypes_here))),
      linetype = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        subgroup_level,
        " (N=", nrow(data), ")"
      ),
      x = "Threshold Probability",
      y = "Net Benefit",
      color = NULL
    )

  list(
    dca_result = dca_result,
    dca_tbl = dca_tbl,
    plot = p,
    nia_tbl = dcurves::net_intervention_avoided(dca_result) %>% as_tibble(),
    nia_plot = {
      dca_result |>
  net_intervention_avoided() |>
  plot(smooth = TRUE) +
  aes(color = label, linetype = label) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Treat All" = "solid",
    "Treat None" = "dashed",
    "Age > 35" = "solid",
    "Age > 40" = "solid",
    "Age > 45" = "solid"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Treat All" = "black",
      "Treat None" = "black",
      "Age > 35" = "#1b9e77",
      "Age > 40" = "#d95f02",
      "Age > 45" = "#7570b3"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Treat All" = "Screen All",
      "Treat None" = "Screen None",
      "Age > 35" = "Age > 35",
      "Age > 40" = "Age > 40",
      "Age > 45" = "Age > 45"
    )
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = c("solid", "dotted", "solid", "solid", "solid"))),
    linetype = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(subgroup_level, " (N=", nrow(data), ")"),
    x = "Threshold Probability",
    y = "Net interventions avoided",
    color = NULL
  )
    }
  )
}

subgroups <- list(
  list(name = "Gender", var = "gender"),
  list(name = "Aboriginal", var = "aboriginal"),
  list(name = "HIV", var = "hiv"),
  list(name = "HBV", var = "hbv"),
  list(name = "Hazardous alcohol use", var = "hazardous_alcohol_use"),
  list(name = "Obesity", var = "obesity")
)

subgroup_outputs <- subgroups %>%
  map(function(sg) {
    var <- sg$var

    df_sg <- df_dca %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
      mutate(.level = as.character(.data[[var]])) %>%
      group_by(.level) %>%
      group_nest() %>%
      mutate(
        n = map_int(data, nrow),
        events = map_int(data, ~ sum(.x$outcome_cirrhosis, na.rm = TRUE)),
        res = map2(data, .level, ~ run_dca_subset(.x, subgroup_name = sg$name, subgroup_level = .y))
      ) %>%
      filter(!map_lgl(res, is.null)) %>%
      mutate(
        plot = map(res, "plot"),
        dca_tbl = map(res, "dca_tbl"),
        nia_plot = map(res, "nia_plot"),
        safe_level = map_chr(.level, sanitize_level),
        csv_file = paste0("Results/Subgroup/DCA_Subgroup_", sanitize_level(sg$name), "_", safe_level, "_net_benefit.csv")
      )

    # Save per-level outputs
    walk2(df_sg$dca_tbl, df_sg$csv_file, ~ write_csv(.x, .y))

    df_sg %>%
      mutate(subgroup = sg$name) %>%
      select(subgroup, level = .level, n, events, csv_file, plot, nia_plot)
  })

subgroup_results <- bind_rows(subgroup_outputs)

# Write an index (without embedding plot objects)
subgroup_index <- subgroup_results %>%
  select(-plot)
write_csv(subgroup_index, "Results/Subgroup/DCA_Subgroup_Index.csv")

# Patchwork panels for HIV and HBV
make_two_panel <- function(results, subgroup_name, left_level, right_level, out_file) {
  dfp <- results %>%
    filter(subgroup == subgroup_name, level %in% c(left_level, right_level)) %>%
    mutate(level = factor(level, levels = c(left_level, right_level))) %>%
    arrange(level)

  if (nrow(dfp) != 2) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  panel <- (dfp$plot[[1]] | dfp$plot[[2]])

  panel_saved <- panel +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  ggsave(out_file, plot = panel_saved, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  panel
}

make_two_panel_nia <- function(results, subgroup_name, left_level, right_level, out_file) {
  dfp <- results %>%
    filter(subgroup == subgroup_name, level %in% c(left_level, right_level)) %>%
    mutate(level = factor(level, levels = c(left_level, right_level))) %>%
    arrange(level)

  if (nrow(dfp) != 2) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  panel <- (dfp$nia_plot[[1]] | dfp$nia_plot[[2]])

  panel_saved <- panel +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  ggsave(out_file, plot = panel_saved, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  panel
}

# Combined panel with all subgroup panels
# To guarantee a single legend, strip legends from all plots except one.
get_plot <- function(results, subgroup_name, level_name) {
  out <- results %>%
    filter(subgroup == subgroup_name, level == level_name) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1)
  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(NULL)
  out$plot[[1]]
}

p_gender_f <- get_plot(subgroup_results, "Gender", "Female")
p_abor_i <- get_plot(subgroup_results, "Aboriginal", "Aboriginal and/or\nTorres Strait Islander")
p_abor_n <- get_plot(subgroup_results, "Aboriginal", "Non-Indigenous")
p_hiv_n <- get_plot(subgroup_results, "HIV", "No HIV infection")
p_hiv_p <- get_plot(subgroup_results, "HIV", "HIV infection")
p_hbv_n <- get_plot(subgroup_results, "HBV", "No HBV infection")
p_hbv_p <- get_plot(subgroup_results, "HBV", "HBV infection")
p_haz_n <- get_plot(subgroup_results, "Hazardous alcohol use", "No hazardous alcohol use")
p_haz_y <- get_plot(subgroup_results, "Hazardous alcohol use", "Hazardous alcohol use")
p_obese_n <- get_plot(subgroup_results, "Obesity", "Not obese (BMI < 30)")
p_obese_y <- get_plot(subgroup_results, "Obesity", "Obese (BMI ≥ 30)")

all_needed <- list(p_gender_m, p_gender_f, p_abor_i, p_abor_n, p_hiv_n, p_hiv_p, p_hbv_n, p_hbv_p, p_haz_n, p_haz_y, p_obese_n, p_obese_y)
if (!any(map_lgl(all_needed, is.null))) {
  # Keep legend only in the first plot
  p_gender_f <- p_gender_f + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_abor_i <- p_abor_i + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_abor_n <- p_abor_n + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_hiv_n <- p_hiv_n + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_hiv_p <- p_hiv_p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_hbv_n <- p_hbv_n + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_hbv_p <- p_hbv_p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_haz_n <- p_haz_n + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_haz_y <- p_haz_y + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_obese_n <- p_obese_n + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_obese_y <- p_obese_y + theme(legend.position = "none")

  combined <- wrap_plots(
    list(
      (p_gender_m | p_gender_f),
      (p_abor_i | p_abor_n),
      (p_hiv_n | p_hiv_p),
      (p_hbv_n | p_hbv_p),
      (p_haz_n | p_haz_y)
      ,
      (p_obese_n | p_obese_y)
    ),
    ncol = 2
  ) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  ggsave("Results/Subgroup/DCA_Subgroup_All_Panels.png", plot = combined, width = 14, height = 14, dpi = 300)
}
```

# Subgroup DCA — CSPH as outcome

```{r}
run_dca_subset_csph <- function(data, subgroup_name, subgroup_level) {
  if (nrow(data) < 50 || n_distinct(data$outcome_csph) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  dca_result <- dca(
    formula = outcome_csph ~ strategy_age35 + strategy_age40 + strategy_age45,
    data = data,
    thresholds = threshold_grid,
    label = strategy_labels
  )

  dca_tbl <- dca_result %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(label_display = legend_label(as.character(label)))

  breaks_here    <- legend_breaks(unique(dca_tbl$label_display))
  colors_here    <- color_map(breaks_here)
  linetypes_here <- linetype_map(breaks_here)

  p <- dca_tbl %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = net_benefit, color = label_display, linetype = label_display)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = plot_xlim, ylim = plot_ylim) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors_here, breaks = breaks_here, name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = linetypes_here, breaks = breaks_here, name = NULL) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = unname(linetypes_here))),
      linetype = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(subgroup_level, " (N=", nrow(data), ")"),
      x = "Threshold Probability",
      y = "Net Benefit",
      color = NULL
    )

  list(
    dca_result = dca_result,
    dca_tbl    = dca_tbl,
    plot       = p,
    nia_tbl    = dcurves::net_intervention_avoided(dca_result) %>% as_tibble(),
    nia_plot   = {
      dca_result |>
        net_intervention_avoided() |>
        plot(smooth = TRUE) +
        aes(color = label, linetype = label) +
        theme_classic() +
        scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
          "Treat All" = "solid", "Treat None" = "dashed",
          "Age > 35" = "solid", "Age > 40" = "solid", "Age > 45" = "solid"
        )) +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = c(
            "Treat All" = "black", "Treat None" = "black",
            "Age > 35" = "#1b9e77", "Age > 40" = "#d95f02", "Age > 45" = "#7570b3"
          ),
          labels = c(
            "Treat All" = "Screen All", "Treat None" = "Screen None",
            "Age > 35" = "Age > 35", "Age > 40" = "Age > 40", "Age > 45" = "Age > 45"
          )
        ) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
        guides(
          color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = c("solid", "dotted", "solid", "solid", "solid"))),
          linetype = "none"
        ) +
        labs(
          title = paste0(subgroup_level, " (N=", nrow(data), ")"),
          x = "Threshold Probability",
          y = "Net interventions avoided",
          color = NULL
        )
    }
  )
}

df_dca_csph <- df_dca %>%
  mutate(outcome_csph = as.integer(fsm_20 == 1))

subgroup_outputs_csph <- subgroups %>%
  map(function(sg) {
    var <- sg$var

    df_sg <- df_dca_csph %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
      mutate(.level = as.character(.data[[var]])) %>%
      group_by(.level) %>%
      group_nest() %>%
      mutate(
        n      = map_int(data, nrow),
        events = map_int(data, ~ sum(.x$outcome_csph, na.rm = TRUE)),
        res    = map2(data, .level, ~ run_dca_subset_csph(.x, subgroup_name = sg$name, subgroup_level = .y))
      ) %>%
      filter(!map_lgl(res, is.null)) %>%
      mutate(
        plot      = map(res, "plot"),
        dca_tbl   = map(res, "dca_tbl"),
        nia_plot  = map(res, "nia_plot"),
        safe_level = map_chr(.level, sanitize_level),
        csv_file  = paste0("Results/Subgroup/DCA_CSPH_Subgroup_", sanitize_level(sg$name), "_", safe_level, "_net_benefit.csv")
      )

    walk2(df_sg$dca_tbl, df_sg$csv_file, ~ write_csv(.x, .y))

    df_sg %>%
      mutate(subgroup = sg$name) %>%
      select(subgroup, level = .level, n, events, csv_file, plot, nia_plot)
  })

subgroup_results_csph <- bind_rows(subgroup_outputs_csph)

# Two-panel plots (CSPH outcome)

nia_panel_csph_obesity   <- make_two_panel_nia(subgroup_results_csph, "Obesity",              "Not obese (BMI < 30)",                  "Obese (BMI \u2265 30)", "Results/Subgroup/NIA_CSPH_Subgroup_Obesity_panel.png")

# Combined all-panels (CSPH outcome)
cp_gender_m  <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "Gender",               "Male")
cp_gender_f  <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "Gender",               "Female")
cp_abor_i    <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "Aboriginal",           "Aboriginal and/or\nTorres Strait Islander")
cp_abor_n    <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "Aboriginal",           "Non-Indigenous")
cp_hiv_n     <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "HIV",                  "No HIV infection")
cp_hiv_p     <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "HIV",                  "HIV infection")
cp_hbv_n     <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "HBV",                  "No HBV infection")
cp_hbv_p     <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "HBV",                  "HBV infection")
cp_haz_n     <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "Hazardous alcohol use", "No hazardous alcohol use")
cp_haz_y     <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "Hazardous alcohol use", "Hazardous alcohol use")
cp_obese_n   <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "Obesity",              "Not obese (BMI < 30)")
cp_obese_y   <- get_plot(subgroup_results_csph, "Obesity",              "Obese (BMI \u2265 30)")

all_needed_csph <- list(cp_gender_m, cp_gender_f, cp_abor_i, cp_abor_n, cp_hiv_n, cp_hiv_p, cp_hbv_n, cp_hbv_p, cp_haz_n, cp_haz_y, cp_obese_n, cp_obese_y)
if (!any(map_lgl(all_needed_csph, is.null))) {
  cp_gender_f <- cp_gender_f + theme(legend.position = "none")
  cp_abor_i   <- cp_abor_i   + theme(legend.position = "none")
  cp_abor_n   <- cp_abor_n   + theme(legend.position = "none")
  cp_hiv_n    <- cp_hiv_n    + theme(legend.position = "none")
  cp_hiv_p    <- cp_hiv_p    + theme(legend.position = "none")
  cp_hbv_n    <- cp_hbv_n    + theme(legend.position = "none")
  cp_hbv_p    <- cp_hbv_p    + theme(legend.position = "none")
  cp_haz_n    <- cp_haz_n    + theme(legend.position = "none")
  cp_haz_y    <- cp_haz_y    + theme(legend.position = "none")
  cp_obese_n  <- cp_obese_n  + theme(legend.position = "none")
  cp_obese_y  <- cp_obese_y  + theme(legend.position = "none")

  combined_csph <- wrap_plots(
    list(
      (cp_gender_m | cp_gender_f),
      (cp_abor_i   | cp_abor_n),
      (cp_hiv_n    | cp_hiv_p),
      (cp_hbv_n    | cp_hbv_p),
      (cp_haz_n    | cp_haz_y),
      (cp_obese_n  | cp_obese_y)
    ),
    ncol = 2
  ) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  ggsave("Results/Subgroup/DCA_CSPH_Subgroup_All_Panels.png", plot = combined_csph, width = 14, height = 14, dpi = 300)
}

nia_needed_csph <- list(np_c_gender_m, np_c_gender_f, np_c_abor_i, np_c_abor_n, np_c_hiv_n, np_c_hiv_p, np_c_hbv_n, np_c_hbv_p, np_c_haz_n, np_c_haz_y, np_c_obese_n, np_c_obese_y)
if (!any(map_lgl(nia_needed_csph, is.null))) {

  np_c_hbv_n    <- np_c_hbv_n    + theme(legend.position = "none")
  np_c_hbv_p    <- np_c_hbv_p    + theme(legend.position = "none")
  np_c_haz_n    <- np_c_haz_n    + theme(legend.position = "none")
  np_c_haz_y    <- np_c_haz_y    + theme(legend.position = "none")
  np_c_obese_n  <- np_c_obese_n  + theme(legend.position = "none")
  np_c_obese_y  <- np_c_obese_y  + theme(legend.position = "none")

  nia_combined_csph <- wrap_plots(
    list(
      (np_c_gender_m | np_c_gender_f),
      (np_c_abor_i   | np_c_abor_n),

}
```
